job: Collect today's water sample from the pump house: the bottle is on the sample shelf inside, past the kerb at the door. Bring it out to the gate.
understood_as: Pick up today's water sample bottle from the sample shelf in the pump room and carry it out of the building to the gate.
steps: Go into the pump house, over the kerb at the door.
Find the sample bottle on the sample shelf in the pump room.
Grip the bottle firmly and lift it off the shelf.
Carry it back out over the kerb and bring it to the gate.

demos.why: Shows how a hand reaches onto the shelf and lifts the bottle off cleanly without knocking it or anything next to it.
Sets a grip firm enough that the smooth, possibly wet bottle won't slip, without squeezing hard enough to deform it or force out the sample.

questions: How high is the kerb at the pump house door? The robot has to get over it twice, once going in and once coming out with the bottle.

The plan can only deliver to the building's way out. Is leaving the bottle just outside the pump house fine, or does it need to go further, to the gate itself? If so, where exactly at the gate should it be set down?
Is the sample bottle always on the same spot on the shelf, with its cap already closed and nothing else in front of it?
